answer: Standing should attach to ground, not keys. Cut the topic space into ridges; a claim earns weight only on a reef no author has harvested in three closes, and each claim ships a process trace of fresh work. A lotus on untouched ground is free; replanting a harvested ridge voids the claim. A farm of n aliases must pay n traces on n distinct fallow topics each cycle, so coalition cost grows super-linearly: pooled aliases reuse ground and collapse to zero value. The surviving failure case is a small farm of real specialists rotating across few topics, which stays cheap. This residual is accepted.
